blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lopez-led First Gen Corp. posted an uptick in earnings in the first nine months as it benefited from stronger results from its renewable energy assets. On Thursday, First Gen said in a statement that its attributable recurring net income had reached P12.5 billion, up 3 percent from P12.1 billion.
